description: The future of the datacenter is heterogeneous, with different types of co-processors for specialized workloads. Bitfusion provided virtualization products for these co-processors, abstracting the underlying hardware, increasing efficiency, allowing scaling and reducing development time.

Bonsai Micro is a fabless semiconductor company that is combining machine learning and advanced RF design techniques to deliver unprecedented power efficiency performance to 5G mmWave wireless networks. The company's technology will produce energy and cost savings for wireless equipment makers, wireless operators, and consumers.

Bridgit develops mobile-first construction software that streamlines communication between the General Contractor and Subcontractor teams. Using Bridgit Bench, companies can ditch the spreadsheet and enjoy pain-free workforce planning. Using Bridgit Field, companies can save time, money, and effort in closeout inspection management by streamlining communication and creating checklists to suit their specific needs.
focus: Workforce and inspection management software for construction

description: Canalyst is a fast-growing fintech company serving institutional investors. Their 4,000+ global models and fundamental data products help analysts and portfolio managers save time in their research, efficiently ramp up and expand coverage, and generate better investment ideas.
focus: 4,000+ financial models with every KPI that matters

description: Chainalysis is the undisputed industry leader in crypto compliance infrastructure, serving as the trusted standard for blockchain investigations and monitoring for customers including the FBI, IRS, Europol, and global banks. With its unmatched depth and breadth blockchain attribution data, Chainalysis provides government agencies, regulators, and financial institutions the tools to detect illicit activity, monitor blockchain transactions, formulate regulations, and ensure compliance as the crypto economy expands.
focus: Trusted standard for blockchain compliance data

description: Cogniac leverages modern advances in deep learning and hyper parameter optimization in order to automate a wide range of mission-critical visual inspection tasks in verticals like automotive, forest products, and rail. Cogniac's no-code platform can achieve better-than-human accuracy and continuously improve inspection workflows with minimal technical input required from subject matter experts.

Dyspatch offers a cloud-native, email production platform that enables company teams to collaborate and create rich, interactive customer emails without writing computer code. Interactive emails can contain embedded forms, applications, and surveys directly within the email. Normally, this requires a team of programmers. Dyspatch enables teams to create these emails on their own.

Echodyne makes revolutionary compact solid-state beam-steering radar sensors for a range of existing and new applications for industry and government. Echodyne’s patented MESA™ technology uses metamaterials to create a platform for innovative radar products for government and commercial customers and allows the company to deliver a true electronically scanning array (ESA) radar at commercial prices.
femtoAI is commercializing a scalable, energy-efficient, neuromorphic computing architecture that improves power consumption in edge computing devices.

Forterra develops advanced robotic vehicle autonomy technology designed to enhance safety, security, and operational effectiveness in transportation and mission-critical environments. The company is building the operating platform for defense from the ground up and is the leading provider of autonomous ground platforms for mission-critical vehicles. Forterra is the only provider participating in every U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) ground autonomy program and is partnered with every major original equipment manufacturer (OEM) in the sector.

goTenna is a pioneer in secure, jam-resilient, and off-grid communication solutions tailored for mission-critical applications such as emergency response, defense, and security. goTenna's technology is rapidly deployable without cell towers, Wi-Fi, or satellites, ensuring reliable connectivity in remote or compromised environments. goTenna technology easily integrates with existing communication devices and is currently trusted in operations by customers like the US Customs and Border and Patrol.

#paid is a creator marketing platform that sits at the intersection of brand and creator collaboration. Founded in 2014, #paid helps direct-to-consumer and Fortune 500 brands like Phillips Hue, Everlywell, Unilever, and Sephora, activate creators to drive growth. They are building the platform of record that powers content creation and distribution for brands globally. The better they do that, the better they can serve their creator community and provide them with the best place on earth to do what they love—create.

HEAVY.AI (formerly OmniSci) is the creator of the HEAVY analytics platform, used by business and government to find insights in big data sets that overwhelm mainstream analytics tools. The HEAVY platform, available in cloud, open source, and enterprise versions, harnesses the massive, parallel computing architecture of GPUs to enable breakthrough performance at scale.

HyTrust provides administrative control, visibility, auditing and data security for private, hybrid and public clouds. HyTrust virtual appliances provide the essential foundation for cloud control, visibility, data security, management and compliance. HyTrust mitigates the risk of breach or catastrophic failure— especially in light of the concentration of risk that occurs within virtualization and cloud environments. With HyTrust, organizations can now confidently take full advantage of the cloud, and even broaden deployment to mission-critical applications. HyTrust solutions are used worldwide by Fortune 1000 organizations including Visa, McKessen, Intel, Bank of America and Lockheed Martin.
Index Biosystems is developing a bioengineered baker’s yeast to solve supply chain challenges including product counterfeiting, food safety, and certification.

Mojo Vision is developing breakthrough µLED displays using proprietary quantum dot technology to create full colour displays with far superior performance than anything available on the market today. Mojo Vision's displays are poised to disrupt the massive global market for high-performance displays in current and emerging mass-market devices, from AR/VR to smartwatches, smartphones, and televisions and laptops.

NeuroBionics is a neurotechnology company developing minimally invasive endovascular neuromodulation to make powerful neural therapies more accessible. NeuroBionic's platform uses flexible, hair-thin bioelectronic fibers to reach neural targets through the vasculature, avoiding the need for invasive surgery. By enabling both deep brain stimulation (DBS) and peripheral nerve stimulation (PNS) through a vascular route, the platform has the potential to transform treatment for a wide range of conditions, including Parkinson’s disease, essential tremor, stroke, epilepsy, chronic pain, and depression.
focus: Expanding access to neuromodulation therapies with seamless interfaces

description: North Vector Dynamics is a Canadian defence technology company that is tackling cost-asymmetry in drone defence by solving the core technical problem behind low-cost counter uncrewed aerial systems (CUAS): precision autonomous guidance on inexpensive hardware. They are building reliable, attritable, low-cost autonomous kinetic drone interceptors for group 1-3 threats that remain effective in the communication and guidance jammed environments where modern CUAS engagements happen.

Olyns aims to help solve the massive global problem of plastic waste by developing a scalable, profitable single-use container recycling network. The company builds “reverse vending machines” that let people insert used beverage containers and receive rewards by logging in through their smartphone. The machines are placed in high-traffic locations like the lobbies of grocery stores, who are willing to provide prime real estate since they are often legally required to accept container returns and the machines save labour costs for the store. Olyns leverages these high-visibility locations by having their machines double as large digital advertising displays, which delivers far more revenue than container recycling alone can.

Planet operates the largest constellation of Earth Observation satellites in the world, having launched over 500 satellites to date, of which approximately 200 are in orbit collecting imaging the Earth’s entire landmass twice daily on average. Planet’s unparalleled dataset now contains over 1,000 images of most locations on the Earth. Customers typically use its imagery to conduct regular monitoring and span many verticals, including agriculture, defense & intelligence, insurance, and energy and infrastructure.

Plantiga’s Tiga™ Platform provides a tool set for better decision making in sports, for players, coaches and the entire organization. Their technology allows teams to capture motion data in real-time providing actionable insights for each player, each practice and each game. Beyond sports, the Tiga platform is applicable in healthcare, rehabilitation, logistics, biometrics and beyond. Record it. Read it. Review it. The new three R’s.

Plotly is a Montreal-based data visualization software company that offers a web-based data visualization suite for composing, editing, and sharing technical visualizations. Plotly’s flagship product, Dash, is an easy-to-use platform to both build and deploy interactive dashboards that provide a meaningful frontend to backend analytics.

Privacy Analytics Inc. is a developer of data anonymization solutions allowing companies to manage privacy requirements of their data while enabling it for analytics and collaborative use. Their software suite, PARAT, anonymizes structured and unstructured data in an iterative, statistically-backed process which can demonstrate privacy compliance as an audit tool. For healthcare analytics, PARAT has operationalized the HIPAA privacy guidelines, allowing an automated process for the anonymization and de-identification of healthcare data to preserve its analytic integrity.Privacy Analytics’ software can be found in over half of Fortune’s Top 50 Healthcare Companies as well as leading research, academic and commercial organizations, such as the National Institute of Health (NIH), National Research Council (NRC), McKesson and GE Healthcare.
focus: Automated data anonymization to enable analytics, collaboration and compliance

description: The capacity of a quantum computer to perform meaningful computations is determined by the quantity of its qubits, but also by the quality of those qubits. Harnessing the power of quantum computing requires overcoming errors and other imperfections that are inevitable in all quantum computing hardware architectures. Quantum Benchmark’s True-Q is a suite of software products targeted at makers and users of quantum computers, across all quantum computing hardware architectures. The technology is based on years of research by several of the world’s leading experts in quantum computing.
focus: Error characterization and suppression software for quantum computers

description: Raxium is developing the next generation of display technology. Their ultra-high density monolithic RGB µLED displays will deliver unmatched performance in a tiny package, enabling a massive step forward in augmented reality, virtual reality, and glasses-free 3D experiences.

Recon Instruments is the world-leading, award-winning innovator of Heads-up Display (HUD) technology for action sports and passionately leads the innovation of customized solutions for direct-to-eye communications. The company integrates Micro Optics Display (MOD) systems with state-of-the-art sensors and GPS technology, providing real-time access to navigation, communication, and performance-based information. Their MOD product be found in Ski goggles from Oakley, Smith, Zeal and Scott. The first HUD for biking, the Recon Jet, was launched in Q2 of 2015.
focus: The first Heads Up Display for sports

description: Rigado’s edge solutions power more than 300 global customers and 5 million connected devices across Commercial IoT solutions such as Asset Tracking, Smart Lighting, and Sensing and Monitoring in markets like Smart Workplaces, and Connected Retail and Logistics. Rigado recently announced Cascade, its integrated Edge-as-a-Service solution for IoT edge connectivity, computing and security. Offered as a simple monthly subscription, Rigado Cascade reduces the complexity, risk and cost of large-scale commercial IoT deployments.
focus: Secure and Scalable Edge as a Service for the Internet of Things

description: RoosterBio is a stem cell tools and technology company focused on accelerating the field of regenerative medicine by providing standardized stem cell platforms. The company has standardized how stem cells are purchased, manufactured and used in development and clinical trials, leading to time and costs savings for their customers.
focus: Stem cell tools and technologies for regenerative medicine

description: SensorUp provides a geospatial movement intelligence platform to enhance safety and operational efficiency for workforces with complex physical operations. SensorUp offers real-time geospatial AI that identifies operational inefficiencies and simplifies critical decision making. Dr. Steve Liang, SensorUp founder and CTO, wrote the Open Geospatial Consortium’s (OGC) data exchange standards for Internet of Things implementations, and SensorUp developed the first and most complete software that adheres to those standards.

SpaceX is the world’s leading space launch provider and is at the forefront of the growing commercial space industry. SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

Tegus is a developer of an investment research platform designed to provide buy-side primary data and analysis. The company's platform offers qualitative insights into idea screening and facilitates custom-sourced calls with industry experts, former employees, customers, and competitors; enabling investors to increase their return on investment and reduce investment risk.
Unity is the world's leading platform for creating and operating interactive, real-time 3D content.
focus: The world's leading platform for creating and operating interactive, real-time 3D content.

description: Hundreds of companies worldwide rely on the vArmour to consistently and effectively apply security controls across hybrid clouds, reduce the attack surface, and maintain continuous compliance. Powered by its Security Graph technology, vArmour helps enterprises gain a clearer picture of application relationships and how they are interconnected across their diverse environments. With the ability to easily integrate with existing IT and security infrastructure, vArmour enables enterprises to unlock more value out of the investments they’ve already made. From vulnerability reduction, to monitoring and detection, to incident response, to compliance, vArmour’s relationship-based approach is an elegant solution for a complex problem.

Vendasta Technologies is a leader in digital marketing and brand management solutions for small to mid­-sized local businesses. VendAsta provides white label solutions to media companies that work directly with local businesses, including online directional media companies, newspapers, broadcasters, SEO services, certified marketing representatives, web hosting providers, and interactive agencies. VendAsta’s reputation management platform includes Reputation Monitoring, Brand Analytics, Presence Builder, Social Marketing lead generation tools and Concierge CRM platforms to help manage and sell digital products. Today, over 10,000 digital sales representatives across 250 media organizations, including Hearst Media and The McClatchy Company, provide VendAsta powered solutions to over 90,000 local businesses.
focus: The only platform that allows you to monitor, manage, and build your company's online reputations

description: Vodasafe is the company behind Aquaeye, a handheld waterproof device that uses sonar to scan any body of water to locate submerged persons. The product is inexpensive, easy to use and saves the precious time needed to locate and rescue people in life-threatening aquatic situations.
focus: Handheld sonar device for search and rescue

description: Wurldtech is a software company providing protection for mission critical connected devices against the persistent and dynamic threat of cyber attack. Wurldtech follow their customers’ security lifecycle by providing innovative assessment products to discover threat and vulnerability profiles; automated testing for device vulnerabilities with Achilles® Test Appliance; device and development practice certification through Achilles Certification, and mitigation of known vulnerabilities in installed networks with Achilles Threat Intelligence Signatures. Wurldtech employs internationally recognized cyber security experts who help industrial stakeholders identify and mitigate cyber security vulnerabilities to reduce the risk and cost of attacks. Wurldtech solutions are currently used by global customers worldwide including, Siemens, Schneider, Shell, Wind River to name a few spanning from Oil & Gas, Electric Power, Medical, Nuclear, Chemical and Water Treatment markets. Wurldtech was acquired by GE in 2014.
focus: Protecting critical infrastructure from cyber attacks

description: xAI, founded by Elon Musk, is a company working on building artificial intelligence to accelerate human scientific discovery. Equipped with proprietary access to vast volumes of valuable data from X (formerly Twitter) and Tesla, along with an abundance of capital, xAI is uniquely positioned to overcome some of the fundamental challenges in AI and establish itself as one of a select few platform companies that will come to dominate the massive future AI market. Its first product, Grok, is a chatbot available on its own via xAI and is being used by X to deliver real time news and posts synthesis for paid users.

xCures is a healthcare data company focused on improving healthcare outcomes by increasing the value of medical records. Its Clinical Clarity Engine is built on almost a decade of work in the most complex area of medicine, oncology, and is now used across all clinical domains, scaling across care and workflows. The Engine extracts decision-ready data from medical records retrieved across U.S. healthcare systems and delivers it via a web UI or a developer-friendly API. Every answer links to its source document, enabling teams to make better-informed decisions.
focus: Automatically bring clinical clarity to medical records
